articles.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
articles.snippet: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

articles.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
articles.snippet: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

articles.title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
articles.snippet: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trading in tight range near $83,000 ahead of key U.S. inflation data
articles.snippet: The September CPI report comes out on Wednesday, with economists expecting a sizable increase in the headline number but a softening in the core rate.

articles.title: Bitcoin diverges from South Korean stocks as AI concerns deepen the Kospi selloff
articles.snippet: South Korea’s chipmakers lead another sharp selloff as concerns over AI spending and Chinese competition grow, while bitcoin holds well above its summer lows.
